A single superfile whose FTS section is version 9, written by the engine at
commit `bd9369d5`, the last to write that version. It holds 6,000 rows of a
`doc_id` (`Decimal128(38, 0)`, equal to the row index) and a positional FTS
column `body`, generated by the `corpus` function in
`tests/superfile/fts/old_format_superfile.rs`.

That corpus is shaped so the file carries every posting and position form the
version-9 writer produced: packed, presence-bitset and patched posting blocks
whose tfs are stored as they are (header bit 31 clear), with tfs above one in
each; packed position groups whose exceptions are varint pairs, in both the
first-position and the gap streams; a short list's varint position group;
short-form lists; and a single-document term.

The test opens it with the current reader and checks that it answers exactly
as the same corpus written by the current writer does. It also asserts that the
FTS section is version 9, so a file regenerated by a newer writer fails it.

## Regenerating

Regenerate only if the version-9 format itself must change, which it should
not: the point of the fixture is that old files keep working. At commit
`bd9369d5`, add `examples/gen_v9_fixture.rs` holding the constants, `Rng` and
`corpus` of the test file (from `N_DOCS` through `corpus`), followed by:

```rust
use std::sync::Arc;

use infino::{
    arrow_array::{LargeStringArray, RecordBatch},
    arrow_schema::{DataType, Field, Schema},
    superfile::builder::{BuilderOptions, FtsConfig, SuperfileBuilder},
    test_helpers::decimal128_ids,
};

fn main() {
    let out = std::env::args().nth(1).expect("output path");
    let docs = corpus();
    let schema = Arc::new(Schema::new(vec![
        Field::new("doc_id", DataType::Decimal128(38, 0), false),
        Field::new("body", DataType::LargeUtf8, false),
    ]));
    let opts = BuilderOptions::new(
        schema.clone(),
        "doc_id",
        vec![FtsConfig::new("body").positions(true)],
        vec![],
    );
    let mut b = SuperfileBuilder::new(opts).expect("builder");
    let ids = decimal128_ids(0..N_DOCS);
    let bodies = LargeStringArray::from(docs.iter().map(String::as_str).collect::<Vec<_>>());
    let batch =
        RecordBatch::try_new(schema, vec![Arc::new(ids), Arc::new(bodies)]).expect("batch");
    b.add_batch(&batch, &[]).expect("add_batch");
    std::fs::write(&out, b.finish().expect("finish")).expect("write");
}
```

with a `[[example]]` entry `name = "gen_v9_fixture"`,
`required-features = ["test-helpers"]` in `Cargo.toml`, then run
`cargo run --release --features test-helpers --example gen_v9_fixture -- v9.sf.parquet`.
